Ninja Development

Use this independent system to develop an existing ninja through training, combat, new techniques, chakra development, ability growth, recovery, setbacks, and breakthroughs. It does not advance the Character Creation Wheel.

Load a generated/logged ninja, or enter an existing ninja manually. All fields remain editable before development.
